quiz_title: Quiz 3: Number Theory, String Palindromes & 2D Matrices

questions.title: Greatest Common Divisor (GCD)
questions.problem_statement:
Given two non-negative integers A and B, compute their Greatest Common Divisor (GCD).
If both numbers are 0, output 0.

### Input Format
Two non-negative space-separated integers `A` and `B` (0 <= A, B <= 1,000,000,000).

### Output Format
Print gcd(A, B) followed by a newline.

questions.title: Palindrome String Verification
questions.problem_statement:
Given a single alphanumeric string S (length up to 100, no whitespace), check if it is a palindrome ignoring case (e.g. 'A' == 'a'). Output `YES` if palindrome, `NO` otherwise.

### Input Format
A single string `S` on one line without spaces.

### Output Format
Print `YES` or `NO` followed by a newline.

questions.title: Matrix Transpose
questions.problem_statement:
Given an R x C matrix of integers, compute and print its transpose (a C x R matrix).

### Input Format
First line: Two space-separated integers `R` and `C` (1 <= R, C <= 50).
Following R lines: `C` space-separated integers per line.

### Output Format
Print `C` lines, each containing `R` space-separated integers, followed by a newline.
